message: ビッグブリッジな死闘

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't seen that Pasta kid around lately.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How pathetic, getting discouraged after losing just once.」

name: Misa
message: 「It was exam season, too, so maybe she's surprisingly good at reading the room.」

name: Synn
message: 「I really doubt that's why, though...」
We split up and continue our patrol, yet there's nothing out of the ordinary.
If anything, it's so quiet that it's actually scary.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Maybe Senpai and the Treasurer actually went and defeated her by accident without telling us.」

name: Synn
message: 「We agreed to contact each other if we run into any Demons, so I think they're fine, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「If they get ambushed out of nowhere, you never know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All clear! Think that's about it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Let's hurry back and have some tea\s07」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyah-fu-fu-fuu! Splitting up to patrol? There are limits to stupidity, nya!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait... Macaroni?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's Pasta, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Not that you two even need to bother remembering Pasta's name, nya. Because--」

name: Pasta
message: 「This is the place where you're gonna bury your bones, nyaaaa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What is that...?!」

name: Ria
message: 「That sound... So many Demons!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya~fufu~no-fu~♪ This is the final battle uniting the full might of Team Pasta, nyan!」

name: Pasta
message: 「First, I'm gonna pay you two back in full for getting in my way over and over again, nyan!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「As for the others, I'll take my sweet time cooking them up right after this, nyan\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What do we do, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「We don't have time to calmly call for backup...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, close your eyes for a second」

name: Ria
message: 「Here goes!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya?! What are you planning to do, nyan?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaaah, so bright!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan. Let's run!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Notice us, Synn...!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Using intimidation--how underhanded, nya. I'll catch you right away and give you a cat-beating instead of an octopus-beating, nyaaa!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, it's chasing us!!」

name: Ria
message: 「No choice, I'll buy us some time!」
